title: Entry Router: Prompt, Session & Command Activation
brief: Task classifier for 9 classes (backend/web/CAD-Python/roadmap/audit/speed-feed/post/print-to-program/ERP-quote). Bundle resolution for context loading. Chain attachment to route classified tasks into the correct automation chain.

units.title: Build 9-class task classifier (backend/web/CAD-Python/roadmap/audit/speed-feed/post/print-to-program/ERP-quote) with confidence scoring
Implement bundle resolution: load context bundles (files, instructions, schemas) per task class
Implement chain attachment: route classified tasks to correct automation chain from ACP-MS0A schema
Wire entry router into UserPromptSubmit hook for automatic activation on every prompt
Test classifier accuracy across 50+ sample prompts, verify <500 token budget for router

exit_conditions: 9-class task classifier operational with >90% accuracy on test set
Bundle resolution loads correct context per task class
Chain attachment routes to correct automation chain
Entry router stays within <500 token budget
